subject: Align senior technical stakeholders — VP/CTO intro & 30m infra deep dive
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.in>
To: Priya Sharma <priya@edgeapps.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.in>
Date: Thu, 18 Sep 2025 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Align senior technical stakeholders — VP/CTO intro & 30m infra deep dive

Hi Priya,

Thanks again for the call this morning — helpful to hear more about EdgeApps’ inference scale goals and where the latency/cost tradeoffs are creating product constraints. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

- Recap: you’re running a mix of LLMs in prod (1–2B and occasional 7B), peak bursts at ~3000 qps, and you’re evaluating options to reduce per-token cost while holding 95th percentile latency under 250ms.
- Next step (blocking): introduce Aman (CTO) and schedule a short senior-technical handshake with a 30-minute infra-focused deep dive to align on pilot scope and stakeholders.

Proposed slots (PT):
- Mon, Sep 22 — 10:00–10:30
- Tue, Sep 23 — 09:30–10:00
- Wed, Sep 24 — 11:00–11:30

If none work, send a couple of preferred windows and I’ll coordinate. I’ll include Marissa (AE lead) and Karthik (our infra/solutions engineer) on the invite so the right technical folks are present.

Attached: redwood-demo-runbook.pdf (summary of demo flow) and a draft mutual_action_plan.xlsx to capture success criteria and pilot gates.

Suggested 30-min agenda (can trim to 20):
1) 5m — intros & success criteria
2) 15m — infra/deployment constraints (KV cache, batching, quantization tolerance)
3) 5m — pilot gating and next steps
4) 5m — scheduling: dedicated pilot vs hosted proof-of-value

Thanks — want to make this as painless as possible for your execs.

—
Jonas Weber
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.in | +1 (415) 555-0142

Attachment: redwood-demo-runbook.pdf (application/pdf)
Attachment: mutual_action_plan.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: Priya Sharma <priya@edgeapps.io>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.in>
Cc: Aman Gupta <aman.gupta@edgeapps.io>
Date: Thu, 18 Sep 2025 17:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Align senior technical stakeholders — VP/CTO intro & 30m infra deep dive

Jonas — thanks for the recap and the materials. Looping in Aman, our CTO.

Aman, quick context: we had a strong discovery with Jonas today. We need a short infra-level conversation so leadership is comfortable with the pilot approach.

Prefer mornings PT next week. Of your options, Tue 09:30 or Wed 11:00 would work better for us, but if you have anything earlier on Tue that’s even better.

Also could you send a 1-page pre-read focused on:
- what the pilot will prove (latency targets + cost savings expectation)
- required infra changes on our side (networking, GPU footprint, KV cache persistence)

Thanks — Priya
Head of Product, EdgeApps
priya@edgeapps.io | +1 (650) 555-0199

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.in>
To: Priya Sharma <priya@edgeapps.io>, Aman Gupta <aman.gupta@edgeapps.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.in>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.in>
Date: Thu, 18 Sep 2025 18:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Align senior technical stakeholders — VP/CTO intro & 30m infra deep dive

Thanks Priya — great, I’ll lock Tue 09:30 PT for now pending Aman’s confirmation.

Aman — nice to e-meet you. I’ve added Marissa (AE lead) and Karthik (our solutions/infra lead) to the thread. For the 30-minute deep dive we’ll keep the agenda tight:

- 5m: quick intros + desired pilot outcomes
- 15m: infra constraints and instrumentation (KV cache, batching expectations, model variants)
- 5m: pilot gates & success metrics (SLOs, telemetry we’ll collect)
- 5m: next steps & ownerships

Karthik, can you prepare a 1-slide pre-read that summarizes the runtime choices we’ll present (quantization tradeoffs, batching/latency expectations) — I’ll attach it to the calendar invite.

I’ve tentatively attached the runbook and MAP — updated MAP includes pilot acceptance criteria we discussed.

If Aman confirms, I’ll send a calendar invite for Tue 09:30–10:00 PT with a short meeting note.

—
Jonas Weber
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.in
Attachment: mutual_action_plan.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: Aman Gupta <aman.gupta@edgeapps.io>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.in>, Priya Sharma <priya@edgeapps.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.in>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.in>
Date: Fri, 19 Sep 2025 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Align senior technical stakeholders — VP/CTO intro & 30m infra deep dive

Jonas / Priya — thanks for the context and for looping me in. Tue 09:30 PT works for me; please send a calendar invite.

Requested focus for the 30m: quantify the expected latency lift with your batching + KV cache approach (numbers at 95th/99th), and a concise list of infra changes we’d need to make to support a short pilot (networking, memory/KV persistence, and any client-side SDK changes). If you can include a 1-page pre-read or an architectural sketch that calls out where KV cache lives and what persistence guarantees you expect, that would be ideal.

Karthik — can you join the call and be prepared to speak to runtime options and quantization tolerance?

I’ll accept once I have the invite and the pre-read.

—
Aman Gupta
Chief Technology Officer | EdgeApps
aman.gupta@edgeapps.io | +1 (415) 555-0188
